name: AR
description: World tracking over the device camera — ARKit on iOS, ARCore on Android, WebXR (immersive-ar over ARCore) in Chrome on Android, elsewhere on the web the camera under the scene turned by the sensors: planes, hit tests, anchors, image targets, QR-code targets (the contract's; the WebXR arm tracks them — qr-anchor's wasm — the native halves not yet), the estimated light. The app's side is ARScene.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: The app uses the camera to place things in the room around you.
